description: Compact AWS terminology and concept knowledge for deterministic answer evaluation and lightweight model context.

service_families.name: Amazon API Gateway
service_families.description: A managed service for creating and operating APIs that route requests to backend integrations.

service_families.name: AWS Budgets
service_families.description: A budgeting service that tracks cost or usage against configured thresholds and sends notifications.

service_families.name: AWS CloudTrail
service_families.description: A service that records AWS account activity and API events for governance and auditing.

service_families.name: AWS CodeBuild
service_families.description: A managed build service that runs commands defined for a build project.

service_families.name: AWS Config
service_families.description: A service that records supported resource configuration state and evaluates configurations against rules.

service_families.name: Amazon DynamoDB
service_families.description: A managed NoSQL database family for key-value and document workloads.

service_families.name: Amazon EC2
service_families.description: The AWS virtual compute service family for running instances and related compute resources.

service_families.name: AWS Identity and Access Management
service_families.description: The AWS identity and authorization family for principals, policies, roles, and permissions.

service_families.name: Amazon Kinesis
service_families.description: A family of services for ingesting and processing streaming data.

service_families.name: AWS Key Management Service
service_families.description: A managed service for creating and controlling encryption keys.

service_families.name: AWS Lambda
service_families.description: The AWS serverless compute family for running functions in response to requests or events.

service_families.name: Amazon S3
service_families.description: The AWS object storage family for buckets, objects, and their lifecycle controls.

service_families.name: AWS Secrets Manager
service_families.description: A managed service for storing, retrieving, and rotating application secrets.

service_families.name: Amazon Simple Queue Service
service_families.description: A managed message queue service for decoupling producers and consumers.

service_families.name: Amazon Virtual Private Cloud
service_families.description: The AWS virtual networking family for isolated networks and network controls.

concepts.name: CodeBuild buildspec
concepts.description: A buildspec defines the install, pre-build, build, and post-build commands that CodeBuild runs.

concepts.name: build phases
concepts.description: Build phases organize ordered install, pre-build, build, and post-build work within a CodeBuild buildspec.

concepts.name: test commands
concepts.description: Test commands are invocations run by CodeBuild as commands declared in a buildspec phase.

concepts.name: AWS Budgets
concepts.description: AWS Budgets tracks cost or usage against configured limits and can notify stakeholders.

concepts.name: cost thresholds
concepts.description: Cost thresholds are actual or forecasted budget limits that can trigger AWS Budgets notifications.

concepts.name: alerts
concepts.description: Budget alerts notify recipients when configured AWS Budgets conditions are reached.

concepts.name: AWS Config
concepts.description: AWS Config records supported resource configuration state and evaluates resources against compliance rules.

concepts.name: configuration history
concepts.description: Configuration history is the time-ordered record of supported resource configuration changes captured by AWS Config.

concepts.name: compliance rules
concepts.description: AWS Config rules evaluate resource configurations against managed or custom compliance expectations.

concepts.name: Secrets Manager
concepts.description: AWS Secrets Manager stores, retrieves, and rotates application secrets.

concepts.name: database credentials
concepts.description: Database credentials are usernames and passwords managed as secrets instead of being embedded in application code.

concepts.name: scheduled rotation
concepts.description: Scheduled rotation replaces a secret automatically according to a configured Secrets Manager schedule.

concepts.name: SQS visibility timeout
concepts.description: The SQS visibility timeout is the period in which a received message stays hidden from other consumers.

concepts.name: processing window
concepts.description: The SQS processing window is the time a consumer has before a received message can become visible again.

concepts.name: hide message from other consumers
concepts.description: After an SQS consumer receives a message, the visibility timeout temporarily hides that message from other consumers so the current consumer can finish processing it.

concepts.name: AWS KMS
concepts.description: AWS KMS is the managed service for creating and controlling encryption keys.

concepts.name: encryption keys
concepts.description: Encryption keys are cryptographic keys whose use and access can be controlled through AWS KMS.

concepts.name: key management
concepts.description: Key management covers the lifecycle, permissions, and controlled use of encryption keys in AWS KMS.

concepts.name: AWS CloudTrail
concepts.description: AWS CloudTrail records AWS account activity and API events.

concepts.name: API activity
concepts.description: API activity consists of management or data events produced by calls to AWS APIs and recorded by CloudTrail.

concepts.name: auditing
concepts.description: Auditing uses CloudTrail event history to understand which actions occurred and which identities performed them.

concepts.name: S3 Lifecycle
concepts.description: S3 Lifecycle rules transition or expire objects automatically based on configured criteria.

concepts.name: object expiration
concepts.description: Object expiration is the automatic removal of S3 objects by a Lifecycle expiration action.

concepts.name: API Gateway
concepts.description: Amazon API Gateway is a managed API front door that routes requests to configured backend integrations.

concepts.name: Lambda authorizer
concepts.description: A Lambda authorizer runs custom authorization logic for an API Gateway request before the backend is invoked.

concepts.name: custom authorization
concepts.description: Custom authorization uses application-specific logic, often in a Lambda authorizer, to allow or deny API Gateway requests.

concepts.name: backend integration
concepts.description: A backend integration connects an API Gateway route to a target such as an AWS Lambda function.
